show_all_files.description: Display all files including those beginning with a period (.). Corresponds to -a.

enable_function_keys.description: Use function keys for commands. Corresponds to -f.

operating_directory.description: Sets operating directory. Only files within this directory are accessible. Corresponds to -o <dir>.

single_column_display.description: Enable single vertical column display. Corresponds to -v.

hide_keymenu.description: Disable keymenu at the bottom of the screen. Corresponds to -x.

enable_suspend.description: Enable ^Z suspension of pilot. Corresponds to -z.

mail_check_interval.description: Interval in seconds to check for new mail. Corresponds to -n<seconds>. Min 30, default 180.

use_termcap_sequences.description: Use termcap/terminfo for input escape sequences. Corresponds to -q.

no_setlocale_collate.description: Do not perform setlocale(LC_COLLATE). Corresponds to -no_setlocale_collate.
